task.title: Record the real-model authoring quality gate on L4b and L1
task.objective: At 1126c1b6 verify:ai-authoring-quality-live sends L4b's labelled set (six flows, two issues each, twelve L4a codes, both fix kinds) through explainFlowValidation on the real Qwen3.5-0.8B and passes 10/0: 6 of 6 delivered, 12 of 12 explained, no canary or residual secret, 12 of 12 on subject by the proxy, 0 misattributed, 0 of 3 fixable issues ranked. Append a note to awkit-djnl.6 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the gate, the result and what stays open (no explanation quality target is recorded, which L4b's acceptance criteria require; verify:ai-error-quality-live not built; the owner's go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the gate commit and its live result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents: 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: authoring quality gate noted on awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
